input: Renew my professional association membership online

gold.taskDescription: The user wants to renew their professional association membership through the association's online portal or website.

questions.title: Which professional association are you renewing with?
questions.description: Identify the specific association by name so the correct renewal process can be followed.

questions.title: When does your current membership expire?
questions.description: Determine the expiration date to assess urgency and avoid a lapse in membership.

questions.title: Do you still have your login credentials for the member portal?
questions.description: Confirm whether the user can access their account or needs to recover credentials first.

questions.title: Which membership tier or level are you renewing at?
questions.description: Clarify if there are multiple membership levels and whether the user is staying at the same tier or upgrading.

questions.title: Are you renewing for yourself or on behalf of others?
questions.description: Determine if this is an individual renewal or involves a team, group, or company account.

questions.title: What payment method do you plan to use?
questions.description: Identify the preferred payment option such as credit card, PayPal, or invoice to ensure it is ready.

questions.title: Do you need a receipt or invoice for reimbursement purposes?
questions.description: Find out if the user needs to save or submit proof of payment after completing the renewal.
